title: Ladder 14 · Convīvium amīcitiae (the party for friendship)
summary: Gaius throws an office party on Thursday so that friendship may grow: Quintus is ordered to have fun, Marcus finds a ring in the pasta and must sing first, the new young man Publius sings magnificently and envy grows instead; late that night the coffee machine, still humming, has been covered with a napkin and nobody admits it (Friday: it burns). B1 mix: ut + subjunctive, quī-clause with passive iubētur, indirect question, cum + subjunctive with invideō + dative, perfect passive.
